title: Timeline: Add Motion Guide missing from layer context menu
description: The 'Add Motion Guide' command exists in jsfl/runtime.ts (addMotionGuide) but is never wired to any UI menu. In Timeline.tsx around the LayerTypeMenuPopup (line 2096), add an 'Add Motion Guide' menu item that inserts a guide layer above the selected layer and sets the selected layer type to 'guided'. The JSFL runtime already has the logic; wire the UI to call it via the dispatch mechanism.
